question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off `tools.exec.pty` config default for non-sandbox exec, or keep PTY as a per-call-only tool parameter?
rationale: The source reproduction is clear, but the requested fix adds a global shell-exec default that affects security-sensitive operator behavior and sandbox/approval expectations.

options.title: Approve Narrow Config Default
options.body: Add the optional default while preserving current default behavior, per-call override precedence, and explicit sandbox suppression/warning coverage.

options.title: Keep Per-Call Only
options.body: Do not add another exec config knob, and instead improve docs or skill guidance for calls that need PTY.

options.title: Defer For Exec Policy Review
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers decide a broader exec configuration and PTY policy direction.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Config Default
recommendation.body: Add the optional default while preserving current default behavior, per-call override precedence, and explicit sandbox suppression/warning coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest history signal for the original PTY behavior and adjacent exec runtime/docs decisions.
